title: Before And After
paragraphs: “It feels… really ominous, or rather, like the place has completely fallen into ruin.”

From the direction of the tavern, I can hear loud, vulgar laughter. Peeking inside, I see a group of crude-looking individuals drinking and partying, all while emitting some kind of purplish aura. Rather, it seems that all the energetic people here are releasing that same strange-colored aura. And they all share the common trait of looking like terrible people.
“It’s safe to say that law and order have completely collapsed.”
“They preach about doing things ‘for the sake of the world,’ stirring up the people, yet the country they took over is in shambles. Just what kind of religion is this?”
“For a group that’s been the state religion for so long, they sure are a strange one.”
“This is odd… From what I’ve heard, even if things were happening beneath the surface, they were supposed to be maintaining a facade of order…”
Many of the shop signs are tilted. Why does the whole place have the atmosphere of a town on the verge of becoming a ruin?
“What the hell is that!?”

Ren pointed toward the sky, so I followed his gaze. A sinister-looking, demonic creature was flying overhead. What in the world… This place has undergone a complete “before and after” transformation into a cursed city.

At first glance, it may seem peaceful, but this was once the capital of a country that discriminated against demi-humans, tormented them, and falsely accused the Shield Hero of crimes he never committed. Now, it has been fully transformed into a lawless land where even the most casual observer would immediately recognize it as a dark and evil place, with demons soaring through the skies. It’s as if a craftsman with an eye for irony gave this country the perfect makeover.
“Could it be that something happened right before we arrived?”
“At this point, I can’t even say that’s impossible.”
“There’s a special route in Dimension Wave lore about this. One where the ruler of a nation summons an evil demon, and then that demon takes over the country.”
“Wait… demons actually exist in this world?”
When Father asked, both the Queen and Rival nodded.
“Yes. However, it’s extremely rare to actually encounter them.”
“They exist.”
“How are they different from demi-humans?”
“They are classified as monsters. They cannot communicate with demi-humans or any other races.”
“They are monsters. Magical creatures constructed from mana itself.”

Ah, so they occasionally appear in places designated as “quest zones.” But originally, I recall them being described as entities that only manifest under the influence of the Waves. Since I haven’t encountered any in all the previous loops, they must be a type of monster that is exceptionally rare. Even undead-type monsters only appear in specific locations where they are meant to exist.
“When unraveling the knowledge of the Dragon Emperor, it’s said that these creatures were created by an entity once called the Demon King.”
“So that means they’re magical beings created by someone who was once a Hero?”
“That’s right!”
“It might be best to categorize them as special monsters embedded within the world itself.”
“And it looks like some of them have already noticed us.”
A demon that detected our concealment dove straight toward us.
“I’ll take care of it. Silent Shot V!”
Bang! Itsuki fired his gun straight into the forehead of the demon that had spotted us. With just that single shot, it completely vanished. It seems to be even more powerful than a real gun.
“We managed to maintain our concealment. Let’s keep moving for now.”
“Y-yeah… but still…”
Father and the others took another look around the capital.
“It’s unbelievably lawless here. There are so many people collapsed in the streets… It feels like the country isn’t even functioning at a basic level anymore.”
“Yes… We need to investigate exactly what’s happening.”
“Yeah.”
And so, we proceeded straight through the streets of the capital. On the way, we came across the weapon shop.
“Huh? It’s closed…”
As we approached the shop, we saw a sign on the door indicating it was out of business. That means the old man might still be safe.
“It looks like it closed… about a week ago. The date is written here.”
“Did he leave because of the worsening security? The old man from the weapon shop?”
“I’m not sure… But maybe he couldn’t stay because of his association with us. He was a friendly guy, so I hope we can meet him somewhere else someday…”
Most of the stores in the city had shut down in a similar fashion. The marketplace was nearly deserted.
“Is it that they want to open but can’t? Or is it that they’re in no condition to even try…?”
“Either way, we have no choice but to keep going.”
“I never thought the country would end up like this…”

So, this is what happens when you take down Trash… This is endless… With that thought, we finally arrived at the castle gates. The guards stationed there looked like they were being controlled, swaying unsteadily as they stood watch.
“This is annoying! Let’s just jump over the wall!”
“Yeah, first, let’s get inside the castle.”
“Shouldn’t we split into two or three groups?”
“We don’t know what’s happening yet. It’s better to stick together, thoroughly investigate all the key locations in the capital, and find the source of this.”
“I see… but still…”
“Itsuki, do you have any useful game knowledge for this?”
“In the game, once this quest location appears, you can explore it, but… it becomes impossible to actually clear or purify the place.”
“Ugh… So it’s one of those unwinnable situations?”
“Well, we can’t say for sure yet. If this phenomenon was caused by some kind of ritual, then if we locate where the ritual took place, we might be able to do something about it.”

I suppose you could call it gamer density? Both Itsuki and Father seem to have extensive and in-depth knowledge. On the other hand, Ren feels more like a one-trick specialist, favoring games focused on battles and level grinding.
And me?
I’m all about having fun with everyone—which in online slang means I’m the type to chase after virtual girls like a desperate pig! HAHAHA!

“For now, let’s focus on our first objective—reclaiming the castle. After exposing the identity of that king’s body double, who’s likely in the royal family’s quarters, we can pinpoint the cause of all this.”
“Understood! Then, a preemptive strike! Brionac X!”
“Hey, wait—!”
I blasted open the castle gate head-on with a skill. With a loud explosion, the gate shattered into pieces, sending the guards flying and tumbling to the ground.
“Ugh, come on! Can you think before you act for once?”
“Naofumi.”
Father was about to scold me when Ren called out to him.
“What?”
“Look at that.”
“Huh?”
Father’s eyes widened as he looked at the soldiers sprawled across the castle courtyard. What is this? A synchronized nap session? No, something about this is off…
“W-what is this…?”
“They’re not exactly dead.”

Demons occasionally rained down, but we swiftly eliminated them. With the power of the Heroes, it was an overwhelming victory. The soldiers were still alive, but at this rate, it was only a matter of time before they weren’t.
“It’s like their souls were sucked out.”
“We saw the same thing on our way here. If they’re summoning demons… could they have been used as sacrifices?”
“I don’t know… but there might’ve been signs of this happening ever since the waves started…”
Either way, if they’re not going to use the soldiers against us, it works in our favor. Time for a swift and forceful breakthrough.
“Let’s head inside the castle!”
“Yeah!”
As we entered the castle with Father and the others, we ran straight into a group that appeared to be Three Heroes Church followers.
“The false heroes are here!”
“Kill them! True justice belongs to the Three Heroes Church!”
They shouted as they charged, exuding a suspicious aura. Some of them had grotesquely mutated, likely due to demonic possession.
“Air Strike Shield VI! Holy-element attacks should work well in this situation…”
Father stepped forward, blocking the incoming arrows and spells all at once. Thanks to that, the rest of us could focus on attacking.
“Yeah, that’s why Ren and I are already using them.”
Ren and Itsuki’s weapons had transformed into light-element versions. I’ll make sure to stand out and earn Father’s praise!
